items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled author thm environment at source lines 434-437: any two h-initial natural-number algebras are equal and being h-initial is a mere proposition. The proof (source lines 438-444) is a complete argument that the statement does not display: it extracts a homomorphism in each direction from the contractible hom-types, uses the contractibility of the endomorphism hom-types to identify both composites with the identities, passes to an equivalence and then to an equality by univalence, and finally establishes the mere-proposition character of the property by combining the propositionality of contractibility with the closure of mere propositions under dependent products.
